stumbles.quote: names the Muninn `github` tool call to use instead
stumbles.why: Muninn is never explained, and it's unclear what the `github` tool is or how it differs from `gh`. A reader of the log can't tell what the guard recommends.
The text doesn't say why a session gets a 403, such as a token permission or a sandbox policy. The reason for blocking these calls stays opaque, though this is minor.

point: The commit extends a guard script so that it also blocks `gh api` POST calls to /releases and /git/refs, which it previously missed because it only matched `gh release create`, and it adds tests for the new cases.
